title: OHWARN Mutual-Aid Request — Submitted

fields.to: Denise Albrecht, Director of Water Operations; Priya Nandakumar, SCADA / IT Security Manager
fields.subject: FW: OHWARN Mutual-Aid Request — Submitted
fields.note: The OHWARN mutual-aid agreement has been activated. Two certified operators from the Carver County Water District have been dispatched and are en route. ETA: 10 hours. The request was submitted via the OHWARN portal (MDWS-OHWARN-2026) and confirmed by the Carver County EOC. The incoming staff will be briefed on site and must pass the onboarding checklist (Section 8.4) before being allowed to operate.

original.subject: Mutual-Aid Request: DWS-000124 (Millbrook, OH)
original.body:
Request ID: DWS-000124
Requestor: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
Region: Central Ohio
Type: Certified Operators (2)
Service Level: Critical — Public Health Emergency
Status: Confirmed and Processing
ETA: 10 hours (11:40 AM)
Resource Pool: OHWARN-2022-001
Approved by: Carver County EMA
Portal Reference: MDWS-OHWARN-2026

Note: Requestor has activated Level 3 — Public Health Emergency under ERP Section 4.4. All incoming personnel must complete the onboarding checklist (Section 8.4) before assuming any operational role.

This is a formal mutual-aid activation under the OHWARN 2022 agreement. The EOC will provide status updates every 2 hours via DWS-1 radio channel.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the activation of external support. The Director must acknowledge receipt and update the incident status accordingly. Watch for hesitation in confirming the ETA or questioning the need for onboarding.
